profile.headline: Software Engineer / Robo-wrangler
profile.summary: New Grad from OSU-Cascades, currently working as a Software Engineer at Lexara.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Core contributor (690+ commits) to Lexara's TypeScript, Cloudflare-native legal-tech platform --- an Astro/Workers firm console and an AI client-intake chatbot on Durable Objects and Claude AI.

Built the Volunteer Lawyers Project intake pipeline end-to-end: a 300\%-federal-poverty-line eligibility classifier, an org-centric referral engine (decision tree + RAG over Cloudflare R2/AutoRAG), AI-generated referral emails, and grant-ready reporting with CSV export.

Built data and workflow systems on Cloudflare D1 (SQLite) and Durable Objects --- conversation lifecycle/event tracking, multi-role access control, and 70+ versioned migrations with CI schema-drift detection.

Integrated Auth0, Mailgun, and CRM connectors (Monday.com, PracticePanther, Clio) via OAuth with AES-GCM credential encryption; built the GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline and migrated the test suite to Playwright + Vitest.

positions.title: Google - Cellular Operations Technician
positions.description: Handled the maintenance, inventory, and distribution of Google’s refurbished corporate cellular devices for the Mountain View region. Established best practices to ensure accurate and honest reporting of inventory. Provided technical support and customer service to users via tickets, chat support, and walk-ins.

positions.title: Technical Support Analyst
positions.description: Provided remote technical support to Intermountain Healthcare’s 40,000 employees. Duties included being the Manager on Duty after hours for Incident Management and compiling daily statistics of call volume for the service desk. Trained Physicians and Nurse Practitioners in the use of iCentra, an electronic medical records application based on Cerner Millennium.
